uat_packages.title: Paid journey
uat_packages.requirements: PAY-001–009: purchase, webhook/callback race, premium grant, receipt and re-download.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Sandbox tests plus authorised low-value live purchase/refund before public launch.

uat_packages.title: Guided editing
uat_packages.requirements: EDT-001–010: all 12 guided templates, long fields, tables, omissions and concurrent tabs.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Golden sample comparison, Word/PDF opening and revision-conflict tests.

uat_packages.title: AI drafting
uat_packages.requirements: AI-001–009: all four tasks, invalid output, quota, timeout and injection cases.
uat_packages.required_evidence: 60-case rubric; ≥95% pass; zero critical leakage or invented legal claims.

uat_packages.title: Requirements
uat_packages.requirements: CMP + RUL: source-backed AI-reviewed applicability, unknowns, coverage gaps and historical/current versions.
uat_packages.required_evidence: 80-scenario expected-output suite; all critical decisions and exclusions pass.

uat_packages.title: Isolation
uat_packages.requirements: IAM, SEC, PRV: other-tenant identifiers, revoked sessions, support roles and private files.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Negative test matrix across every private entity and action.

uat_packages.title: Content governance
uat_packages.requirements: ADM + EDP-001–012: draft/review separation, source expiry, wrong citations, failed tests, holds, withdrawal and rollback.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Separate editorial suite of 60 cases; zero critical false releases; immutable AI/publisher evidence and visible disclosure.

uat_packages.title: Operations
uat_packages.requirements: OPS + NFR: environment separation, load, restore, worker crash and provider outage.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Restore drill, reconciliation result, load report and on-call drill.

uat_packages.title: Privacy
uat_packages.requirements: PRV + WRK: consent, export/deletion request, backup re-delete and no raw-content logging.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Verified processor checklist and end-to-end data-lifecycle test.

uat_packages.title: Enquiry and reminders
uat_packages.requirements: SRV + WRK: actual saved enquiry, consented routing, reminder opt-out and duplicate prevention.
uat_packages.required_evidence: Delivered test email, support ticket, preference and retry records.
